title: In the City
intro: The city is big and busy!

parentTip.vi: Khi đi qua phố, hỏi con "Where can we buy medicine? Where do people send letters?"

chat.ask: Would you like to live in a big city?
chat.no: Okay! The countryside is lovely too.

gaps.s: We drove across the ___ over the river.
I've got a cold. Let's buy some medicine at the ___.
After school, my sister is going to study at ___.

text.title: A Day in the City
lines: Yesterday, Grandpa and I went into the city by bus.
First, we bought some stamps at the post office.
Then we walked across the old bridge and looked at the boats on the river.
Before we went home, we bought some medicine for Grandma at the chemist.

questions.q: How did they go into the city?
What did they buy at the post office?
